text:
kevin-sales: SummitCare wants a short POC (2 weeks) next Tue. Requirements: SAML SSO (encrypted assertions), SCIM push with groups->roles mapping, tenant RBAC, strict domain lock, and Splunk audit forwarding. They asked whether Hosted is OK or if Dedicated/Private needed for CMK. cc @mira-se @leo-eng @anya-sec

mira-se: Quick asks for kickoff: get IdP metadata + encryption cert, SCIM mapping CSV, Splunk HEC URL and token, and whether they need nested groups or role composition. Also confirm push vs pull provisioning.

leo-eng: Notes: SCIM endpoints are /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups; we support PATCH per RFC7644. Hosted POC rate-limit suggestion: <=100 SCIM ops/min. Encrypted SAML assertions supported if we receive their encryption cert. BYOK/CMK requires Private deployment.

anya-sec: Security to flag: provide SOC2 Type II and pen test summary. If they require customer-managed keys or FedRAMP controls, recommend Private. For Splunk HEC we can send HTTPS events; need retention and PII handling requirements.

kevin-sales: SummitCare replied: push SCIM preferred, groups map 1:1 to roles, no nested groups, encrypted assertions required, Splunk HEC v2 with token provided, and they asked for a rough POC cost + delta to Dedicated.

mira-se: Ballpark for planning: Hosted POC credits + token spend estimate $150-400/mo for ~2k calls/day depending on prompt lengths. Dedicated baseline for small reserved capacity ~ $3k-6k/mo. Formal quote from finance after SE input.

leo-eng: I'll prepare a short SCIM mapping template and sample curl for push provisioning. mira, please collect IdP metadata and Splunk endpoint and post here before kickoff.

anya-sec: I'll draft the security questionnaire answers and list mandatory items that push them to Private (CMK, FedRAMP, no-log retention).

kevin-sales: Thanks all. Scheduling kickoff for Tue 10am PT and will attach mapping template. Will post SummitCare mapping here when received. :thumbsup:
